sanskrit: yo mamāra prathamo martyānāṃ yaḥ preyāya prathamo lokam etam | vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasya ||
english: He who died first among mortals, he who departed first to this world — honour with oblation Yama the king, son of Vivasvat, the meeting-place of peoples.

sanskrit: parā yāta pitara ā ca yāta- -ayaṃ vo yajño madhvā samaktaḥ | datto asmabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadrā rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ dadhāta ||
english: Depart, O Fathers, and come back again — this sacrifice of yours is anointed with honey. Grant us here auspicious wealth, and bestow on us riches rich in all heroes.

sanskrit: kaṇvaḥ kakṣīvān purumīḍho agastyaḥ śyāvāśvaḥ sobhary arcanānāḥ | viśvāmitro 'yaṃ jamadagnir vasiṣṭho 'vantu naḥ kaśyapo vāmadevaḥ ||
english: May Kaṇva, Kakṣīvān, Purumīḍha, Agastya, Śyāvāśva, Sobhari the adorers, this Viśvāmitra, Jamadagni, Vasiṣṭha, Kaśyapa, and Vāmadeva protect us.

sanskrit: viśvāmitra jamadagne vasiṣṭha bharadvāja gotama vāmadeva | śardir no atrir agrabhīn namobhiḥ suśaṃsāsaḥ pitaro mṛḍātā naḥ ||
english: O Viśvāmitra, Jamadagni, Vasiṣṭha, Bharadvāja, Gotama, Vāmadeva — may Atri the leader grant us shelter with obeisances; O Fathers of fair praise, be gracious to us.

sanskrit: kasye mṛjānā ati yanti ripram āyur dadhānāḥ pitaraṃ navīyaḥ | āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanena śuddhā bhavantaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ ||
english: Purifying themselves in the waters, they pass beyond sin, bearing a renewed life-span for the Father. Swelling with offspring and wealth, they become pure, bright, and cleansing.

sanskrit: yad vo rudraṃ pitaraḥ somyaṃ ca teno sacadhvaṃ svayaśaso hi bhūta | te arvāṇaḥ kavayo ā śṛṇota suvidatrā vidathe hūyamānāḥ ||
english: Whatever share belongs to you, O Fathers — both the Rudra-nature and the Soma-nature — follow it; for you have become self-luminous. Come swiftly, O seers, hearken to us — you who grant good gifts, when invoked at the assembly.

sanskrit: ye atrayo aṅgiraso navagvā iṣṭāvanto rātiṣāco dadhānāḥ | dakṣiṇāvantaḥ sukṛto ya u stha- -āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvam ||
english: Those who are of Atri and Aṅgiras, the Navagvas, eager sacrificers, bearing the gift-bestowing, possessed of sacrificial fees, well-doers — be seated on this sacred grass and rejoice.

sanskrit: adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtam āśuṣāṇāḥ | śucīd ayan dīdhitim ukthaśasaḥ kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīr upa bruvan ||
english: Just as our ancient Fathers of old, O Agni, hastening toward the Truth, pure they pursued the sacred thought as reciters of hymns, splitting the earths they addressed the red dawns.

sanskrit: sukarmāṇaḥ suruco devayanto ayo na devā janimā dhamantaḥ | śucanto agniṃ vavṛdhanta indram urvīṃ gavyāṃ barhiṣadaṃ na akran ||
english: Of good deeds, of good light, devoted to the gods, blowing like iron-smelters at their birth, the gods — purifying Agni, they magnified Indra; they made wide the cow-rich world for those seated on the sacred grass.

sanskrit: ā yūtheva kṣumati paśvo akhyad devānāṃ yaj janimānty ugraḥ | mārtānāṃ cid urvaśīr akṛpran vṛdhe cid arya uparasyāyoḥ ||
english: Like a herd of cattle lowing in a fruitful place, the mighty one surveyed the births of the gods. Even for mortal men the Urvaśīs lamented — even for the growth of the noble, of the later Āyu.

sanskrit: akarma te svapaso abhūma rtam ajasrann uṣaso vibhātīḥ | viśvaṃ tad bhadraṃ yad vahanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
english: We have become your worshippers, doers of good works; the Dawns shone forth unceasingly in Truth. All that the gods bring is auspicious — may we speak the Bṛhat at the assembly, rich in good heroes.

sanskrit: indro mā marutvān prācyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari | lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ ghṛtabhāgā iha stha ||
english: May Indra with the Maruts guard me from the eastern quarter — the earth flung forward by the arms, like the sky above. We worship those who make the worlds and the paths, you who have the ghee-share of the gods — be here.

sanskrit: dhātā mā nirṛtyā dakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ (…) ||
english: May Dhātṛ guard me from Nirṛti's southern quarter … [remainder of verse as in 18.71.2 pattern].

sanskrit: aditir mādityaiḥ pratīcyā diśaḥ (…) ||
english: May Aditi with the Ādityas guard me from the western quarter … [remainder of verse as in 18.71.2 pattern].

sanskrit: ādityo mā viśvair devair udīcyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari | (…) ||
english: May the Āditya with all the gods guard me from the northern quarter — the earth flung forward by the arms, like the sky above … [closing refrain as in 18.71.2 pattern].

sanskrit: dhartā gha tvā dharuṇo dhārayāty ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā dyām ivopari | lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ ghṛtabhāgā iha stha ||
english: The bearer, the sustainer, truly upholds you — Savitṛ bearing his lustre upward, like the sky above. We worship those who make the worlds and the paths, you who have the ghee-share of the gods — be here.

sanskrit: prācyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadāyām ā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari | (…) ||
english: In the eastern quarter, before the enclosed svadhā-offering, I place you — the earth flung forward by the arms, like the sky above … [closing refrain as in 18.71.2 pattern].

sanskrit: dakṣiṇāyāṃ tvā diśi (…) ||
english: In the southern quarter I place you … [remainder as in 18.71.7 pattern].

sanskrit: pratīcyāṃ tvā diśi (…) ||
english: In the western quarter I place you … [remainder as in 18.71.7 pattern].

sanskrit: udīcyāṃ tvā diśi (…) ||
english: In the northern quarter I place you … [remainder as in 18.71.7 pattern].

sanskrit: ūrdhvāyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyām ā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari | lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ ghṛtabhāgā ihā stha ||
english: In the upper quarter, before the enclosed svadhā-offering, I place you — the earth flung forward by the arms, like the sky above. We worship those who make the worlds and the paths, you who have the ghee-share of the gods — be here.

sanskrit: dhruvo 'si ||
english: You are firm.

sanskrit: dharuṇo 'si ||
english: You are the sustainer.

sanskrit: vaṃsago 'si ||
english: You are the one who goes along the bamboo.

sanskrit: udapūr asi ||
english: You are full of water.

sanskrit: ghṛtapūr asi ||
english: You are full of ghee.

sanskrit: madhupūr asi ||
english: You are full of honey.

sanskrit: vātapūr asi ||
english: You are full of wind.
